brief: The seventeenth statue holding a blue lotus; behind her a carved trio of small worlds like three bowls; Śuka looking from one to the other; Dādī counting on her fingers.

The twenty-first statue wearing a long garland of carved stone flowers, each a different shape, trailing to the floor; Śuka counting on his claws; Dādī tracing the garland from its last flower back to its first; Lubdhaka's foreman following her finger.
The twelfth statue humming with her mouth closed and her hand lightly against her nose, a hint of resonance; Śuka listening with a tilted head; Dādī smiling; lamplight on carved stone.
